$comment: Single source of the tested browser stack. CI installs camoufox.tag and the browser-stack gate checks playwright-core against it. camoufox.linuxX64Sha256 is the SHA-256 of that release's lin.x86_64.zip asset (its GitHub digest without the sha256: prefix); the installer refuses any other bytes, so move it with the tag. camoufox.protocolSha256 and playwrightCore.protocolSha256 (keyed by exact x.y.z version) are the SHA-256 of each side's Juggler Protocol.js as the gate fetches it; the gate refuses bytes that differ from a pin, but only reports, never fails, a version or tag that no pin covers, so move the Camoufox pin with the tag and add the version pin with the playwright-core bump. The values are the tested pair: change only the component being upgraded, and raise testedMinor only after its gate and contract tests pass; scripts/browser-stack/manifest.mjs validates this file.

acceptedDeltas.reason: Sent only when a context uses httpCredentials, which src never does (0 in src). A consumer passing newContext({ httpCredentials }) gets a Juggler protocol error on this pair.
playwright-core 1.63.0 never sends it (0 occurrences in lib/coreBundle.js); re-check when playwright-core is upgraded.
